title: Resource-search-format workflow's grep pre-filter must also catch grouped var(...) declarations
answers: Why does the resource search field-values check miss some ResourceSearchRequest declarations?
Grouped var block not detected by pr-resource-search-result-format check
How to update the grep filter in pr-resource-search-result-format.yml
body: Before running semgrep, the workflow greps for files containing ResourceSearchRequest constructions and fails the job if none are found. A naive `var\s+\w+\s+...ResourceSearchRequest` regex misses grouped declarations like `var (\n  request resourcepb.ResourceSearchRequest\n)` because `var` isn't on the same line as the identifier. The current grep in the workflow adds a second alternative matching a bare `identifier type` line (optionally with a trailing comment) to also catch these. If you edit this pre-filter regex, test it against both standalone `var x Type` and grouped `var (x Type)` forms.
